claims.quoted_text: we can focus on the integer parts
claims.explanation: This is invalid because the irrational terms are not negligible. They combine to \(1144\sqrt{35}\approx 6767.995\), so the full value is \(6768+1144\sqrt{35}\approx 13535.995\), and the greatest integer less than it is \(13535\), not \(6768\).

claims.quoted_text: The non-integer parts will certainly add to this sum but will not affect the greatest integer part of our final result.
claims.explanation: This is false. Those terms sum to \(1144\sqrt{35}\approx 6767.995\), which changes the floor. Hence the greatest integer less than the value is \(13535\), not \(6768\).
